description: FP-hardening regression set (Deliverable 4): realistic marketing/transactional email that MUST NOT be auto-quarantined. Post-Deliverable-2 policy these messages must (a) score at most 'medium' overall and (b) fail the corroboration gate (no provider write). Includes the exact Medium digest payload that caused the live quarantine loop and a mediumday.com event-registration token URL on a brand-secondary domain.

samples.name: medium_digest_email_link
samples.subject: Python stories you might like
samples.body:
Hi reader,

Here are today's Python stories selected for you.

Read more: https://medium.com/@coder6861python?source=email-971ea2707eee-1789158672039-digest.reader

You are receiving this email because you follow Python topics.
Unsubscribe: https://medium.com/me/settings/email
samples.source: live inbox FP loop (quarantine/release cycle, 11 events)
